text:
incident-bot: Paging: service-routing-prod — increased 5xx rates on route /v1/generate. Trigger: latency+errors alert. Auto-escalation to on-call. Please acknowledge.

Alice K: acked. I'm taking first response. seeing spike across 3 regions.

Ben R: on my way, grabbing logs + k8s pods for the route. any customer-facing impact known?

Carmen S: I saw a couple SRE alerts for 503s coming from the kv-cache tier. Could be cache storm.

Alice K: quick triage — `curl` to the service shows 200s for simple ping, but heavy generate requests 503/504.

Devon P: rolling tail of the app logs now: looks like upstream connection pool exhaustion to embedding service.

Erin M: tagging @support — support, do we have any elevated CS tickets?

Frank L: customer metrics show elevated error rate for 2 enterprise customers on dedicated: tenant A and tenant C. Not panicked yet, but visible.

Alice K: mitigation plan: 1) scale routing layer up, 2) switch affected tenants to fallback model variant, 3) enable temporary 429 rate-limit on large requests. Doing step 1 now.

Ben R: scaling pods + increasing connection pool to embedding service. command:

```
kubectl -n prod scale dc/routing --replicas=6
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/routing EMB_POOL=200
```

Carmen S: started canary reroute for tenant A to fallback model (lower memory but more stable) — monitoring response.

incident-bot: Action: mitigation_started by Alice K at 1923456890.

Devon P: after scaling we saw error rate drop ~30% but latency still elevated. embedding service still showing queue depth.

Alice K: temporarily enabled 429 enforcement for payloads > 1MB: `policy: reject-large-requests` — will revert after containment.

Erin M: notified account leads for tenant A and C — they asked for ETA, told them "working on containment, will follow-up with postmortem."

Frank L: logging customer impact, adding to incident doc: https://confluence.redwoodinc/incidents/1923456789 — linking here.

Ben R: note: I saw a regression in recent routing change from PR #4283 that altered connection reuse. Reverting that in progress.

Carmen S: revert applied to staging; deploying to prod now. watch for surge in traffic after deploy.

Alice K: deploy finished. errors trending down to baseline over last 6 minutes. Good.

incident-bot: Incident contained at 1923458400. Severity downgraded to S3; pager cleared.

Devon P: quick post-containment checklist: - capture logs for window - snapshot k8s state - collect heap + pool metrics - pin commit that caused regression

Alice K: assigning postmortem owner — @Ben R will own the PM. Ben, can you run with timeline, root cause, action items?

Ben R: yep — I'll own the postmortem. Tentative due in 4 business days. I'll also list remediation items and owners.

Carmen S: immediate action items I have: 1) add guardrails to connection pool config so we don't over-allocate per-route (owner: Carmen S, due: 3 days), 2) add a circuit-breaker on embedding calls (owner: Devon P, due: 7 days).

Devon P: will do circuit-breaker and add health-check backoff.

Erin M: I'll coordinate communications: craft a customer-facing post-incident summary and follow-up with tenant teams.

Frank L: ops item: add an automated runbook step to revert the routing PR safely and an alert to detect similar regressions. (owner: Frank L, due 5 days)

Alice K: planning a brown-bag to share lessons across infra + product teams: "When reroutes and pool changes collide: safe deploy patterns" — propose Thursday next week, 11:00-12:00.

Ben R: adding postmortem meeting and brownbag to calendar. Also will include a short repro harness for the regression.

Carmen S: can we add an entry to the prevention patterns wiki? quick checklist for deploy owners: run load-sim, check pool settings, staged revert test.

Devon P: agreed. I'll add an automated e2e load-sim job to run on routing change PRs (owner: Devon P, due 14 days).

Alice K: final thing — tagging followups in the incident document with status tracker. We'll review at the oncall retro next week.

incident-bot: Postmortem created: https://confluence.redwoodinc/pm/1923456789-postmortem by Ben R.

Erin M: thanks team — good containment work. We'll use this as a case study for the brownbag. cc: @all-eng for invite. :thumbsup:

Ben R: I'll ping when the draft is ready for review, assigning reviewers: Alice K, Carmen S, Devon P, Frank L, Erin M.

Alice K: closing out here, will hand off remaining action-item tracking to Ben. Good job everyone. :raised_hands:
